headline: Ram Kumar files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Ram Kumar submitted a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) to NSE following a substantial acquisition in RattanIndia Enterprises Limited, triggering takeover code filing requirements.
detail: The filing was submitted to NSE on 30 June 2026 and disclosed 6 July 2026. Under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4) requires an acquirer to make a public disclosure within 2 days of crossing a slab threshold (5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 90%). The disclosure triggers a chain of obligations: if the acquisition is not exempted under Regulation 5, the acquirer must make a public open offer to acquire further shares within 60 days at a floor price set by a registered valuer. This filing alone does not indicate the size or outcome; it is a procedural milestone.
